entries.description: Agent-native, non-custodial bridge from Solana native USDC to Base native USDC and beyond, with 54 active routes: 44 price-verified and 10 availability-only routes with no cheapest-price claim. Another 44 measured routes are inactive. AssetFare service fee exactly 1bp with no service-fee maximum; Circle/provider/network fees are separate and additional. Quotes require fresh confirmation; the server never signs or submits.
